# Tend

> The easiest way for churches to collect prayer requests: one QR code, one inbox.

Tend is a QR-code prayer-request collection app for churches. A church signs up,
prints a QR code, and places it in the sanctuary, bulletins, and lobby.
Congregants scan it with their phone camera and share prayer requests,
check-ins, praises, or questions through a simple form, with their name or
anonymously. Every submission lands in the church's private prayer inbox with
status tracking (new, praying, prayed for, archived). People can also text a
prayer request to the church's Tend number.

## Key facts

- Website: https://tendpray.com/
- Built for churches; anyone on the church team can set it up, not only the pastor.
- Congregants need nothing installed: the phone camera opens a web form.
- Prayer requests are private to the church's signed-in team. Nothing is posted publicly.
- Free plan: free forever, no card required. One QR code and prayer page, no volume limit.
- Church plan: one plan, $49/month (or $490/year), every feature included.
  30-day free trial, no card required to start. Manage or cancel anytime.
- 100% of profits are donated to support orphans through Compassion International.
- Contact: support@tendpray.com
- Privacy: https://tendpray.com/#/privacy
- Pricing: https://tendpray.com/#/pricing

## Features

- QR code and prayer page unique to each church, plus a printable pew card and poster kit.
- Prayer inbox with status tracking and a care team: multiple team members can
  sign in and work the same inbox.
- Text-to-prayer: congregants can text requests to the church's own Tend number.
- 24/7 prayer watches: a full day covered in 96 fifteen-minute slots, with a
  public sign-up page and a pastor dashboard showing coverage and gaps.
- Pray mode (early access): the inbox can be prayed through request by request, hands-free.
- Planning Center sync: prayer requests can flow into Planning Center.

## Gifting

Anyone can gift a year of Tend to their church, no Tend account needed:
https://tendpray.com/#/gift/{church-url-name} (for example, /#/gift/fhbcgr).
The gift is one payment of $490 charged today. It covers a full year and does
not renew. The church's team is notified when a gift arrives, and both the
giver and the church are emailed when the gift year ends.

## How a church starts

1. Sign up at https://tendpray.com/#/signup
2. Tend generates a QR code and prayer page for the church
3. Print the QR poster and place it in the sanctuary
4. Requests arrive in the church dashboard inbox
